name: Order of the Ancestors
body:
Edicts: The xia must protect sites where the dead rest (crypts, graveyards, shrines), monuments of historical significance, and repositories of ancient knowledge (libraries, museums) from destruction or misuse. He must destroy undead wherever encountered and aid those who preserve antiquities.

Challenge: Receives a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls against the challenge target if it is undead or threatens an item or site of antiquity. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels.

Skills: Adds Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (religion) as class skills. He can make Knowledge (history) checks untrained. If trained, adds +1/2 level (minimum +1) on checks involving items or sites of antiquity.

Order Abilities
Ancestral Guidance (Su): At 2nd level, as a standard action, receive an insight bonus equal to Charisma modifier on an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check made within the next minute (declared before rolling). Usable 4 times per day (once per roll type).
Ancestral Feat (Su): At 8th level, choose a daily bonus General, Combat, or Teamwork feat (meeting prerequisites) as a standard action, retained until resting 8 hours. By spending 1 hero point, choose a new ancestral feat as a swift action.
Ancestral Channeling (Su): At 15th level, channel positive energy like a cleric of his level 3 + Charisma modifier times per day.
